note: Re-judged 2026-09-30: TestRFC1195PseudonodeCannotInheritRouterPrefixes gained only the RFC1195-5.3.5-2 and RFC1195-3.4-2 tag comments; the body is byte-identical. The unit fails if the pseudonode LSP carries TLV 128 while the router LSP carries the narrow internal prefix (routerTypes[128] required), and the pseudonode's TLV 22 member entry is the positive. Positive and negative tags sit on the one assertion; the input is the violation attempt.
